text.g02: [softly] …Good evening. I'm Gaku. A campfire by the lake again tonight.
text.g03: [sighs softly] …Enough about my face. [softly] …Watch the fire.
text.g04a: [softly] …Nice to meet you. …Make yourself at home.
text.g06: [softly] …Hear it crackle? The mic is right next to the fire.
text.g08b: [softly] …Good. …But the wind's hitting your left side, isn't it?
text.g13c: [softly] …Thanks for the Super Chat. …Coffee, then. The water's just boiled.
text.g14c: [softly] …Here. The steam's reaching the mic, right? …Warm?
text.g13i: [softly] …Thanks for the Super Chat. …Sweet potato? I've got one in the fire right now.
text.g15: [shy] …It's a solo camp, but… it doesn't feel like I'm alone.
text.g17: [softly] …The mic will get wet. …I'll put this over it.
text.g20: [whispers] …Hey. Could you wait… just a little longer before I end the stream?
text.g21: [whispers] …Everyone keeps talking about my face. …But I really wanted you to hear my voice. [sighs softly] …You.
text.g22: [softly] …Good night, then. …See you on another campfire night.
